attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 678950)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Dragon_Ball_FighterZ
Fandom (dragonball.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://dragonball.fandom.com/wiki/Dragon_Ball_FighterZ
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Fighting game, so chapters follow the modes the achievement descriptions name (each starts with the mode, such as "Arcade -" or "World Match -"). Steam app 678950 was used; the Steam schema gives no game name, and the app list confirms "DRAGON BALL FighterZ". RAWG's first search result matched the expected slug. 5 of 35 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the story chapter; "Conversationalist" (52.7%) and "Set for Life" (2.0%) may not be story, as their unlock rates differ a lot from the others. StrategyWiki has "Dragon Ball FighterZ" at completion stage 1, with a written Table of Contents, a large Moves page (about 53,000 characters), Achievements and trophies, Gameplay and Secrets pages, and short character pages for the roster. Its Walkthrough page and the three story arc pages it links (Super Warrior Arc, Enemy Warrior Arc, Android 21 Arc) are not written, so it was not used for chapters; the Moves page could seed CC BY-SA move lists later. dragonball.fandom.com answers the API under "Dragon Ball FighterZ" with about 272 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Several online goals need other players, and the arena ones are below 11%.
